title_zh: 选举回来了，事情却没有回到原点
title_en: An Election Is Not a Reset
deck_zh: 选票终于发到手里，许多门重新打开。但停下来的滑落、仍留在纸上的旧授权，以及没有答完的问题，不能用同一个“恢复正常”带过去。
deck_en: An election finally takes place. Complaints can be heard again. Yet restored procedures, surviving emergency powers, and unanswered decisions belong to different parts of the story. A return is not a clean slate.
body_zh: 选举的日期终于公布了。对等了很久的人来说，通知上最重要的，也许不是谁说了什么，而是那个可以在日历上圈起来的日子。国家不再只是请他们等待。到了那一天，他们能够走进投票站，把后来由谁在位这件事，重新放到自己的选择里。
《逆相变》沿用的虚构国家目的联合城邦，简称 UCSE，确实走到了这一步。第十一年秋，选举举行；冬天，新的首席执政就任。此前向更封闭方向滑去的那一段，在原案例里停住了。下一篇才讨论另一种设想：如果没有停住，会怎样。两条路线不能混在一起。
但一个令人松口气的日子，也很容易成为故事的句号。既然选举已经回来，是否可以把前面那几年统统放进一个已经结束的抽屉？问题恰恰从这里又开始。重新有机会决定未来，不等于过去已经得到回答，也不等于过去留下的工具已经拆掉。
## 停下来，不是因为一切突然自己好了
回头看，有几处没有完全失守。首席法官遭到弹劾后，成员院十二票赞成定罪、八票反对，没有达到所需的十四票，他因此复职。那份禁止成员单位退出、并写着自身不得修正的统一条款，也没有在同一届民众院任内完成两院表决，依程序失效。这不是大家突然都想通了，而是不同位置没有被同一个决定完全收拢。
这些位置做的事，还不能全叫作把已经关上的门重新打开。成员院可以挡住罢免，可以让新条款过不去，却不能仅凭这个否决，便让拖延的选举照常举行。拦下下一步，与取回此前已经失去的追问办法，是两种作用；前一种很重要，但不能被写成后一种已经发生。
也有一次重要的判断没有兑现。终审法院以六比五认定选举应当举行，执政院说尊重法院，却没有发布选举令。后来选举真的举行了，这一年的不执行仍不能被说成从未发生。那份裁决并非无用：它把问题公开留在了记录里。但有记录，与当时的人已经得到应有的结果，也不是一回事。
还有一条当时没有被使用的路。四个成员单位的议会可以联名提出修宪，交全 UCSE 公投，由各地选举委员会组织，不用等执政院发令。它没有落到被追问一方的许可之下。按原论文提出的辨认办法，正因为这条路尚在，第十年冬那场严重的滑落，还没有走到所有回转通道都受制于同一方的程度。
这句话不能倒过来写成，那条路发动了回转。案例没有说谁走过它，它也未必能在紧急令下获得公平的条件。它说明的是，当时还有什么可能，不是说明后来究竟发生了什么。辨认某种封闭有没有完成，与解释一场回转怎样来到，是两个需要分别找根据的问题。
真正的转折，还接上了外面的变化。第十年春，双方停火；第十一年春，签署撤军协定。第十一年夏，议会两院各以过半数终止战时状态。此前让执政院自行续期的特别安排不再适用，紧急状态的续期回到联席会议；期满没有人提请，便告结束。同月，民众院定下秋天的选举日期。
不能把这一段全记成战争结束的功劳。停火不会自己投出议会里的票，撤军也不会自动使一项条款失效。也不能反过来，证明只要制度还挂着名字，外面发生什么都无所谓。这一次，是外部条件与里面尚能行动的位置接上了。它们怎样接上，可以照实讲；没有其中一样会怎样，不能凭这一个故事就宣称已经知道。
国家头上没有更高一级，并不因此注定回不了头。它只是不能把全部希望放在某位更高的裁判身上。拦住新的越线、使原有问题重新能够被问到，仍要通过里面与旁边那些具体的路。路里有人作判断，也有人承担说出问题的代价；这不构成要求每个普通人都去做英雄的命令。
## 新的名字，可能留着旧的用途
选举以后，有些门确实重新打开了。监察署恢复受理对防卫军的投诉，新监察长获选，公开听证恢复。原先申请替代服务的工程师再作申报，后来获准离籍。战争调查委员会接到记录，也收下经邻国联络处转来的死者家属陈述。这些不是宣传中的一个“正常”，而是一件件重新能够发生的事。
可是，第十四修正案并没有被写成已经废止。它的几款因为战时状态结束而暂时不再适用，不等于从规则里消失。下次再宣布战时状态，它们仍可能重新起作用。过去让监察署长期由代理主持的过渡条款、弹劾后的停职安排，也没有在案例里被写成已经改好。用过一次的工具，还放在原来的柜子里。
第十二年，新一届民众院通过《国家安全法》。言论条款改了，刑期减了，撤籍条款却照原文留下。新多数中，有人当年投过反对票。这一处尤其难用换了谁上台来解释：反对过旧安排的人，也可能留下其中一部分。该看的仍是这一次具体保留了什么，不能凭一张旧选票，替今天所有决定作保。
另一些东西只是换了名称。战时附加税成了重建税，税率没变；征用土地的补偿说战后再议，三年没有议；监听授权的期限仍系在和约签署上。名字变温和了，不代表用途、持续时间与代价也跟着改变。一个人收到的税单，不会因为标题里少了“战时”，就自动轻下来。
这里也不能反过来断言，凡是留下来的都必须立刻撤掉。可能确有新的事情需要做，骤然抽走某项安排也可能留下空缺。原论文给出的要求是另一种：若要继续，就把它当作一项新的、有明确期限的决定，用今天的理由重新说明，而不是借已经过去的危机无限续期。改走普通程序，也不能替掉这一问。
修复还包括把容易被拆的地方做得更难拆。紧急理由能否收窄，哪些事即使紧急也不能暂停，谁来确认续期，拒绝执行时有没有另一条兑现的路，都值得重新安排。但这些是需要具体设计与判断的问题，不是一套散文已经替现实国家写好的法律。门加固了，也不保证以后再没人想拆。
所以，回来与没回来，可以同时发生。一次选举是真正的回来，一项监听的无限延续也是真正的留下。我们不必为了庆祝前者而装作没看见后者，也不必因为后者还在，就把已重新得到的机会一笔抹掉。修复不是一句完成时，而是还能逐项说清的工作。
## 回来的人，也不能拿走最后一句话
最容易越过去的一步，往往出现在自认为正在修复的时候。有人说，那几年的任命都有问题，新来的应该一次清理。若这样做，不必等旧安排回来，新的掌权者已经拿到了同一种能力：由自己判定哪些位置不算数，再由自己决定哪些裁决可以不办。
假如某位法官的任命确实被指违反了门槛，该查的是那一次取得，不是把同一时期的全部任命一并作废。依原论文的哲学要求，应由功能上不受争议任何一方控制的法院逐个认定，不由回来的执政者挑一个顺意的结果。认定取得有问题，也不等于后来所有裁决自动消失。已有终审裁决怎样复核、规则怎样改变，仍各有自己的路。
在认定以前，不同意裁决也不能靠不执行来代替。需要公开说明，进入相应复核，裁决在这段期间仍然有效、仍须照办。这里说的是本系列对修复所持的要求，不是声称所有现实法域都采用同一程序。要紧的是，回来的一方也得把自己的判断放到不能由它独占的追问之下。
过去的事怎样算账，也不能用“追到底”或“向前看”两个口号包办。谁提出延长，谁批准，谁拒绝执行，哪些人因此承受了什么，应当能够查明、记录并得到回答。但账留下，不等于已经证明某人有罪，更不等于每件事都必须追诉。追诉或赦免需要具体的法律与判断；抹掉记录、禁止再问，则是另一件事。
一项错误改正了，也可以有结案的时候。不能从结案推出今后免问，更不能说选举都恢复了，你还提这些做什么。人失去的时间、没有等到的补偿、未执行的裁决，不会因为国家重新有了一个好看的开场就倒退回去。能够修正，并不是修正已经替所有人完成。
选票回到手里，是值得认真庆祝的事。它重新给后来留下了入口。但投票站外的日历不会翻回第九年春。接下去要看的，是那些仍留在规则里的句子、仍没有得到回应的人，以及新上台的人愿不愿意让同样的问题，也够得着自己。
body_en: There is finally a date for the election. For someone who has waited through repeated postponements, the most important part of the notice may be the day itself: a square on the calendar that can at last be circled. Waiting is no longer the only public role available. People will again have a say in who holds office.

This happens in the original fictional case followed by The Reverse Phase Transition. In the United City-States of Ends, or UCSE, elections take place in the autumn of Year 11. A new First Executive assumes office that winter. The slide toward greater insulation from challenge is interrupted. The paper also develops a hypothetical branch in which it is not interrupted; that is a different route, considered in the next essay.

A welcome event makes a tempting final scene. The ballot returns, the old administration leaves, and the country moves on. Yet the opportunity to decide the future does not answer everything that happened in the meantime. Nor does it dismantle powers that remain available for another emergency. A return is not a reset.
## What stopped—and what actually reopened

Some positions had not been brought under a single decision. When the Chief Judge was impeached, the Chamber of Member Units voted twelve to eight for conviction. Fourteen votes were required. He returned to office. A proposed unity amendment, forbidding member units to leave and declaring itself unamendable, also failed to complete the required process in both chambers during the same Chamber of Citizens' term. It lapsed.

Those outcomes mattered without accomplishing everything. Preventing a judge's removal was not the same as making a delayed election happen. Blocking a new restriction did not automatically reopen every route already closed. A brake on the next step and a means of recovering an earlier loss perform different work. We should value the first without quietly claiming the second has occurred.

The Final Court's election judgment illustrates the difference. Six judges to five held that an election must be held. The Executive Council expressed respect for the court but issued no election order. The decision remained a public record of what ought to have happened. Its survival mattered; it did not give people the election when it was due. The later vote cannot turn the earlier refusal to execute the judgment into an event that never occurred.

One other route remained available. Four member-unit legislatures could jointly initiate a constitutional amendment and put it to a UCSE-wide referendum organized by their own electoral commissions. They did not need an executive order. Under the paper's proposed way of identifying completed closure, this unused route matters: even at the low point in the winter of Year 10, not every way back had become dependent on the party being challenged.

But availability is not causation. The case does not say that the member units initiated such an amendment. Emergency restrictions might also have made a referendum unfair. This route establishes what had not yet been closed, not what actually brought the change about. Classifying the condition at that time and explaining the later reversal require different evidence.

The actual turn joined circumstances outside the country to decisions within it. A ceasefire had taken effect in the spring of Year 10. A withdrawal agreement followed in the spring of Year 11. That summer, each chamber voted by a simple majority to end wartime status. The special provision allowing Executive Council renewal of the emergency ceased to apply. Renewal returned to the Joint Assembly; nobody sought it when the period expired, and the emergency ended. The Chamber of Citizens set the autumn election date.

Peace did not cast the parliamentary votes or produce these procedural consequences by itself. Equally, this story cannot prove that surviving institutions would have achieved the same result under any external conditions. The account is narrower: an opening in circumstances met positions and procedures still able to act. It is not a controlled experiment separating the contribution of each.

Having no superior authority did not make reversal impossible. It meant that reversal could not be entrusted entirely to an authority above the state. The work had to pass through particular routes within and beside it. Some were held by officeholders; others depended on people whose questions could reach those offices. This does not impose a duty of heroism on every resident. It asks whether their questions can arrive without retaliation.
## An old power can survive a new name

After the election, there were concrete reopenings. The Inspectorate again received complaints against the defense forces. A new Inspector-General was chosen, and public hearings resumed. An engineer renewed an application connected with alternative service and was later allowed to relinquish citizenship. A war inquiry obtained records and accepted statements from bereaved families transmitted through a neighboring state's liaison office. These are particular changes, not merely a declaration that normal life has resumed.

Yet the Fourteenth Amendment was not recorded as repealed. Its wartime provisions had stopped applying because wartime status had ended. That is different from removing them from the rules. A later declaration could make them operative again. Nor does the case record repairs to every interim-appointment provision, impeachment suspension, or recusal arrangement that had created difficulties. Some instruments remained where another administration could find them.

In Year 12, a new Chamber of Citizens passed a National Security Act. Speech provisions were rewritten and penalties reduced, but the denationalization provision was retained unchanged. Some supporters in the new majority had opposed the wartime law three years earlier. Their earlier opposition does not certify the present decision. A changed holder of power and a changed use of power are separate questions.

Elsewhere the alteration was largely in the label. A wartime surcharge became a reconstruction tax without a lower rate. Compensation for requisitioned land remained something to discuss after the war, with three years passing without that discussion. Surveillance authority still depended on the signing of a peace treaty for its endpoint. A gentler heading does not by itself change a power's function, duration, or cost to the people who bear it.

This does not establish that every continuing arrangement must disappear immediately. A new need may be real, and abrupt withdrawal may leave a gap. The paper's requirement is that continuation be justified as a new, time-limited decision on present grounds. It must not borrow indefinite authority from an emergency whose grounds have passed. Re-establishing something through ordinary procedures does not answer that substantive question for it.

Repair also means asking how vulnerable routes can become harder to close. Narrower emergency grounds, protected activities, renewal arrangements, and alternatives when execution is refused all deserve attention. These are matters for specific design and judgment, not a complete legal code supplied by a philosophical essay. Strengthened safeguards can themselves be weakened later. Their repair is meaningful without promising permanent safety.

Return and non-return can therefore occupy the same scene. The election is a genuine reopening. An indefinite surveillance authorization is a genuine survivor. Acknowledging one does not require concealing the other. Nor should the unfinished work erase the opportunities people really regained. Restoration becomes legible when its parts can still be described separately.
## The people returning must answer too

A particularly tempting shortcut presents itself as repair: declare every appointment from the bad years invalid and clear the institutions at once. But a new executive doing this would acquire a familiar power. It would decide which offices count and then select which judgments need to be obeyed. The old insulation would return under an improved description of its purpose.

Suppose a particular judge's appointment really is alleged to have bypassed the required threshold. The paper's philosophical position is that this particular acquisition should be examined by a court functionally independent of all parties to the dispute. The returning administration does not settle it for itself. A defect in acquiring that position is not a defect automatically assigned to every appointment made in the same period, or to every judgment delivered afterward.

Existing final judgments do not vanish merely because an appointment is challenged. Review and changes to the rules must use their respective routes. Pending the relevant determination, disagreement cannot be expressed by refusing execution: the position argued here is to explain the objection publicly, seek review, and continue to comply. This is the series' normative argument, not a description of a rule common to every actual jurisdiction. Repairers must also leave their decisions open to a challenge they cannot monopolize.

The past requires equally careful distinctions. Who proposed an extension, who approved it, who refused to execute a judgment, and who bore the consequences should remain identifiable. Keeping that account does not establish guilt in advance or demand a prosecution for every wrong. Prosecution and pardon require specific law and judgment. Erasing records or forbidding later questions is a different act; an amnesty cannot simply be treated as a reason why nothing may be discussed.

A correction can bring a particular matter to a close without granting immunity from future questions. Saying that a procedure has been improved does not answer someone whose compensation remains unpaid or whose complaint was never heard. A restored election cannot return the years they lost. It can make an answer possible again, which is not the same as having supplied one.

There is reason to celebrate the ballot's return. It gives later people an opening that had been withheld. But the calendar outside the polling station does not turn back to the spring of Year 9. The next questions concern provisions still on the books, people still waiting, and whether those newly in office will allow the same scrutiny to reach them.
